name: Question 8
problem:
Let $S=\{-4,1,3,7\}$ and suppose

$$
f(-4)=5,\,f(1)=-2,\,f(3)=5,\,f(7)=3.
$$

Compute ${max}_{x\in S}f(x)$ and $\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in S}f(x).$$\,$
${max}_{x\in S}f(x)=$ {{field-1}}

$\,$
$\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in S}f(x)=$ {{field-2}}
worked_solution:
Recall that 

- ${max}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is the largest output value, while

- $\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is an input in $S$ where that largest output occurs.

The outputs are $5,$ $-2,$ $5,$ and $3,$ so the maximum output value is $5.$ This maximum occurs at both $x=-4$ and $x=3.$ Therefore,

$$
{max}_{x\in S}f(x)=5\,\text{and}\,\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in S}f(x)=\{-4,3\}.
$$
